note: Official names and descriptions are as PlayStation publishes them. Every guide below is written in my own words for this entry and names its sources; no guide text is copied from another guide or wiki.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PlayStation — official trophy descriptions

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum unlocks automatically once the other 54 trophies are all earned, so there is nothing to do for this one directly. Work through the roadmap in order — story first, then side characters, collectibles, activities and finally the long grinds — and it pops with the last trophy you earn. Keep the tracker on this page ticked as you go so you always know what is left.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Play the opening mission Gone Fishing and follow its objectives to the end; it is the first mission of the game, so this is unmissable as long as you keep playing the story. If you are stuck on a step, pause and re-read the objective text at the top of the screen before driving on. It unlocks when the mission-complete screen appears.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 1 in story order; the trophy pops on the chapter-complete screen. Do the side content you pass on the way, but do not worry about missing anything here — chapter trophies are story progress, not one-off moments. If a mission fails, replay it from the pause menu and try again.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 2 in story order; the trophy pops on the chapter-complete screen. By this point the map has opened up, so use the gaps between missions to start the collectible and activity trophies in this guide rather than leaving them all for after the story. Chapter progress is tracked in the pause menu if you want to check how far along you are.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 3 in story order; the trophy pops on the chapter-complete screen. This is the middle of the story, so it is a good moment to clear the partner trophies (Hot Together, Retail Therapy) while your partner is regularly beside you in missions. Keep a manual save at the start of the chapter in case you want to replay any mission later.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 4 in story order; the trophy pops on the chapter-complete screen. Chapter 4 is the last chapter before the finale, so before you start the final mission, sweep up any missable trophies flagged in this guide — after the story ends, free roam continues, but story-only moments do not come back.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Play the final mission to its end and watch the credits through to the trophy pop; this is the story's gold trophy and it is unmissable on a normal playthrough. Stock up on armour, ammo and snacks before you start it, and use cover rather than rushing, because a failed attempt just restarts the mission. After it, free roam opens for the cleanup stages of this roadmap.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Breakfast Run by following its objectives; it unlocks in story order, so keep playing missions until it appears. The name is a hint that this one is about a food run, so expect driving and a pickup rather than a shootout. If it does not appear, you have a story mission before it still to finish.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission The Cartel Heist; it is a heist, so expect a planning beat followed by the job itself, and follow the on-screen objectives rather than improvising. Bring full armour and your best weapons, and use your partner's abilities when the game prompts you. The trophy pops at the mission-complete screen.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Child's Play in story order. The title points to a family thread in the story, so play it when it appears on the map and do not skip its cutscenes — the objectives make more sense with the context. It unlocks at the mission-complete screen like every other story mission trophy.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Headliners in story order; the stylised title suggests a big public moment, so expect a set piece with a crowd or a stage. Keep to the mission objectives and use the checkpoints if a section fails — failing a mission never costs you the trophy, it just restarts the section.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission VCIA Takedown, set around Vice City International Airport — the name gives away the location. Expect a vehicle-focused section, so pick a fast car before you start and keep an eye on the minimap for the takedown target. The trophy pops at the mission-complete screen.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Operation Savage Glory; the operation-style name points to a military-flavoured job, so expect heavy resistance and plan for a longer fight. Use cover, keep your health topped up, and let checkpoints carry you through the harder sections. The trophy pops at the mission-complete screen.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% on the in-game completion counter, which counts story missions, stranger strands, collectibles, activities and challenges together — this is the game's second gold and the real end of the roadmap. Check the stats page in the pause menu to see which categories are short, then work through this guide's remaining unticked trophies one category at a time. Do this last: almost every other trophy in the list feeds into the 100% total.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Pull off 250 stunts — jumps, near misses, drifts, airtime and other driving feats — across free roam and missions; the game counts them as you play, so this builds up naturally if you drive fast and take ramps. To grind it, find a long straight road with jumps and traffic, chain near misses and airtime, and watch the counter in the stats page. It is a long grind, so leave it running in the background of the other stages rather than doing all 250 at once.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once — the game's activity list in the pause menu shows which ones you have tried and which are left. Work down that list methodically: one fishing trip, one race, one arcade game, one shooting-range challenge and so on, ticking each off as you go. This is an easy early trophy if you sample one of everything as new activities unlock instead of saving them all for the end.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Visit the shooting range, work through its challenge list one weapon at a time, and replay any challenge that lands silver or bronze until it turns gold. Learn each challenge's target pattern before rushing it — steady aim beats fast spray — and use the weapon the challenge hands you rather than fighting it. The stats page tracks how many golds you have, so you can see what is left at a glance.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations around Leonida. Each location is its own short race, so fly the course once to learn its turns, then race it again for the win; cutting corners through gates and keeping the drone low and fast matters more than top speed. The map marks race locations, so clear them region by region and tick each one off here as you win it.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — each race only counts once, so repeating the same easy race does not help. Work through the race list on the map, using a fast, well-handling car and learning each route's corners on a first run before pushing for the win. Street races, circuit races and any other race type all count as long as the race itself is one you have not won before.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge: head to a fishing spot, start the challenge against Cal, and out-fish him by landing the bigger or better catch the challenge asks for. Watch the line tension and reel steadily rather than mashing — a snapped line loses the fish and the round. If you lose, challenge him again; the trophy only needs one win.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete any one arcade game: find an arcade cabinet in the world, start a game, and play it through to its end screen. Pick the shortest or simplest cabinet you find — a quick game is all it takes, and you do not need a high score. The trophy pops when the game ends, win or lose, as long as you finish it.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's mission strand through to his final mission. Andy's missions appear as side content on the map — take them whenever they show up rather than leaving them, because his strand is a chain and each mission unlocks the next. The trophy pops when his last mission completes; if his icon is not on the map, finish the story mission that unlocks his next step first.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's mission strand through to his final mission; the title hints his strand involves boats, so expect water and docks along the way. Take his missions as they appear on the map and follow the chain to the end. If his missions stop appearing, check the story progress — a later story mission usually unlocks the next one.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's mission strand through to his final mission; the name points to a lone-rider, bike-flavoured strand, so keep a good motorcycle handy for his jobs. Work his missions in order as they appear, and do not leave his strand half-finished while you push the main story — side strands are easiest while their area is fresh in your mind.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 stranger mission strands across Leonida — the question-mark strangers you meet in the open world, each with their own short chain of missions. Explore the map and take every stranger mission you find; Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone each count as one strand, so finishing their five already gets you most of the way there. The trophy pops when the eighth strand's final mission completes.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's mission strand through to his final mission; the name points to a supply-running strand, so expect pickups, deliveries and dealing with rivals. Take his missions as they appear and follow the chain to the end — each one unlocks the next. This strand also counts toward the 8 needed for Strangers & Freaks.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's mission strand through to his final mission; the title hints at a spinning, driving-heavy strand, so expect vehicle work. Take his missions as they appear on the map and follow the chain to the end. Like the other named strangers, his strand counts toward the 8 needed for Strangers & Freaks, so finish him alongside the rest in stage 2.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 meditation spots across Leonida. Meditation spots are quiet scenic points on the map — stand at one and use the meditate prompt, then move on to the next. Work region by region (Vice City, the Keys, the interior) so you do not criss-cross the map, and check the stats page for your count if you lose track. None of them is missable; they are all still there after the story.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt the unique animal Bret asks for: meet Bret, take his hunting job, and track the animal he names to its area — move slowly, watch the wind and the animal's trail, and take a clean shot rather than spooking it. Bring a scoped rifle and approach from downwind. If the animal flees, back off and let it settle instead of chasing it across the map.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 full collectible card sets. Cards are hidden around Leonida — in shops, on shelves, in interiors and out in the world — and the collection screen shows which cards of each set you still need. Pick three sets and hunt them one set at a time, clearing one region before moving on; cards stay where they are, so nothing here is missable. The trophy pops when the third set is completed.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK It feature at 100 different locations around Leonida — each location only counts once, so spread out instead of repeating your favourite spot. WAiNK It is the game's photo/tagging activity: open it at a marked location, take the shot, and move on. Clear it region by region alongside the other collectibles, and check your count in the stats page so you know how many spots are left.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges from the game's challenge list — small goals like stunt counts, race wins, collectibles found and combat feats that tick off as you play. Open the challenges screen and work through the easiest ones first: many complete themselves while you chase other trophies. This is a background trophy — do not grind it in isolation until the end, when you can pick off the 50th from whatever is left.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you in free roam, build a 4-star wanted level — cause enough trouble for the police to escalate to four stars — then lose the cops together and escape. Drive fast, break line of sight, and hide until the stars clear; both of you must be out of the heat when it drops. Do this while your partner is available in free roam, and keep a fast car ready before you start causing trouble.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, rob 3 shops in a row without losing your wanted level — the trick is the opposite of Hot Together: keep the heat, don't lose it. Pick three shops close together, rob each quickly, and drive straight to the next before the wanted level clears; if the stars drop to zero, the chain breaks and you start again. Plan the route first, keep a fast getaway car parked outside, and do it while your partner is with you in free roam.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 different vehicles — drive or ride a vehicle for the first time and it counts as discovered. Work through the vehicle list methodically: city traffic, the docks, the airport, the countryside and car meets all hold different models. If you are stuck near the end, hunt the rare spawns in specific areas rather than driving the same streets, and check the stats page for your discovered count.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies during one use of Combat Focus — the slow-mo aiming mode. Set it up where enemies cluster: start a fight with a group, trigger Combat Focus, and chain headshots while time is slowed. Pick a spot with five or more enemies close together, and do not waste the focus window on one target at a time. If you fall short, retry the same fight — the trophy only needs one good run.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at Vice City International Airport: get onto the airfield, take a plane, and leave without a flight plan — steal one from the runway or a hangar and take off. Expect police attention once you are on the tarmac, so be quick: grab the plane, get airborne, and the trophy pops once you are away. A fast approach on foot or by car through a service entrance works best.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Deal with Rhino tanks — the description's joke is that it gets hot inside them. Get a high wanted level until the military rolls Rhinos in, then take one on: use sticky bombs, heavy weapons or a hijack from behind, and keep moving so its cannon cannot track you. The trophy is about the encounter, so surviving the Rhinos and dealing with one is the goal, not a specific kill count.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected: go in quiet, avoid the cameras and the staff's line of sight, take the goods and leave before any alarm. Scout the store first — note the camera positions and the clerk's patrol — then move in when the coast is clear. If you are spotted, leave and try again another day; the trophy needs one clean run.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape from each one. Each vault is its own job: crack or force the vault, grab the cash, and lose the wanted level before the next. Plan a getaway car for every vault, and do them one at a time rather than rushing — five clean escapes is the whole trophy. The stats page tracks how many vaults you have robbed, so you can see what is left.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape: find one on the roads of Leonida, stop it — block it in or disable it — crack the back open, take the cash and lose the cops. Armored trucks drive set routes, so watch for one, hit it where the road is quiet, and have a fast getaway car waiting. One clean robbery and escape is all it takes.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all 52 areas of Leonida so the whole map is revealed. Drive, fly or sail through every named area — the map shows which regions are still fogged or unvisited. Work outward from Vice City in a sweep, hitting the Keys, the swamps and the interior towns, and mop up the last few areas by checking the map for grey patches. This pairs perfectly with the collectible stages, so do it while hunting cards, meditation spots and WAiNK It locations.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs in Leonida. Gang operations are marked on the map once discovered — hit one per gang, take the goods and escape. Work through the gang list in the stats or intel screen and tick each gang off as you rob its operation; the trophy pops when the ninth gang's operation is robbed.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Go to Ocean Beach, find a beachfront bar, and order a cocktail with a view of the ocean. Sit at the bar or a beach table, order the drink, and enjoy the view — the trophy pops once the cocktail is served and the moment registers. It is a small flavour trophy, so do it whenever you are passing Ocean Beach during the collectible stage.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style: drive a car into a showroom, then floor it straight back out through the glass — the homage is to the classic GTA showroom smash. Pick a showroom with a big glass front, line the car up, and go through it at speed. Expect a wanted level on the way out, so have an escape route ready.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Go to the Kolt & Associates bowling alley and bowl a proper follow-through: play a frame, aim carefully, and follow through on the throw as the game teaches it. The trophy is about doing the bowling activity properly, not about a strike — play the alley's game to its end and the trophy pops. It is a quick one to grab while you are sampling activities for Master of None.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Build a partnership moment with mass appeal — this one is tied to doing something big with your partner that draws a crowd or an audience. Play through the partner content and take the opportunities the story gives you to perform together in public; the description is deliberately vague, so watch for a prompt or a mission beat about reaching an audience. If it does not pop during the story, check the activities your partner offers in free roam.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Make choices — PlayStation tracks a count up to 500 for this one, so it is a long-run trophy about the decisions you make across the game, from dialogue and mission choices to how you handle encounters. Play naturally and the count climbs; if you are close to the end, look for choice-heavy missions and replay them with different decisions to top the counter up. Check the trophy's progress on your PlayStation profile to see how far along you are.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Succeed on your second try at something — the description is a wink: fail once, then get it right the second time. The cleanest way is to attempt a challenge, race or mission, fail it deliberately or naturally, and then pass it on the immediate retry. It pops when the second attempt succeeds, so if a first attempt goes wrong, do not reload an old save — take the retry the game offers you.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Witness something strange — Leonida hides odd, unexplained events, and this trophy pops when you stumble into one. Explore the map's quiet corners at night, visit the odd landmarks, and keep an eye out for anything that does not fit; the moment will be obvious when it happens. It is a discovery trophy, so the best approach is thorough exploration during the collectible stage rather than hunting one spot.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Knock someone over with a melee drive-by: drive past a pedestrian slowly, lean out and swing a melee weapon as you pass, bowling them over. Find a quiet street with pedestrians, line the pass up at low speed, and swing as you draw level — speed makes the hit harder to land, so slow down for the swing. It pops on the first clean knockdown.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 by laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from robberies and heists — take them to a contact who launders them and bank the clean cash, repeating the loop until the $250,000 total is reached. Robberies (vaults, armored trucks, gang operations) are the fastest source of Marked Bills, so this trophy finishes naturally if you do the robbery trophies first and launder everything you steal.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops in Leonida — clothes, weapons, ammo, food, cars and upgrades all count toward the total. Spend normally through the game and the total climbs; near the end, if you are short, buy a big-ticket item like a car or a weapon upgrade to close the gap. Check the stats page for your total spend if you want to know how much is left.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all 8 garage properties around Leonida. Garages go on sale as you progress and earn money — buy each one when it appears, and keep enough cash in reserve for the expensive ones. The property screen shows which garages you own and which are still for sale; the trophy pops when the eighth garage is bought. Save this for the endgame, when money from heists and laundering is plentiful.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app: open the app on your in-game phone, pick a vehicle you own or have found, and register it. Do it with ten different vehicles — a mix of cars, bikes and anything else the app accepts — and the trophy pops on the tenth registration. It is a quick endgame cleanup trophy once you have a decent collection of vehicles to choose from.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
